notes: The potentiometer straddles the breadboard centre gap: its wiper leg is in the half drawn at the top of the image (rows f-j), and its two outer legs are in the half drawn at the bottom (rows a-e).

The catalogue defines bank 't' as rows a-e and bank 'b' as rows f-j. The image labels its top half f-j and its bottom half a-e. I followed the row letters, so the wiper is at 12b.g and the outer legs are at 11t.e and 13t.e.
The pot sits over columns 11, 12 and 13, taken from the labels. Column 12's top label is hidden by the pot.

Outer legs: left (column 11) goes to GND through the black wire, and right (column 13) goes to 5V through the red wire. The wire ends are one row away from the legs, in the same column strips, at 11t.d and 13t.d.
The black wire goes to the second GND pin in the power header, which I mapped to GND.2.
The sketch and Processing/Max software are not physical parts, so they are not in the graph. The Uno's USB cable to the PC is not drawn in the image and is omitted.
